WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.location,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(e.location) <> ''
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
), ranked_events AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        location,
        average_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY location
            ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS event_rank
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE event_rank <= 3;
